The entire primary record is a 19-item Spanish-Guaicaro word list ('Español / Guaïcoro': Charcuish, Lefeskar, Arkayeta, Pellieri, Esnatun, Têl ó Téel, Asfjestail, Huicharek, Hurkúar, Shalki, Yaúlchel, Kekásh, Teregua, Fol Karjk, Merr, Lefeskar, Tercóf, Lektan, Etkastal); a few forms carry acute accents but there is no comment on accent or pronunciation.
